title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one named star has first appearance and disappearance events
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Seek a dated astronomical primary that names one star and writes its heliacal appearance and disappearance as opposite events in a fixed seasonal account. An admitted Voynich astronomical target must independently own the star, its horizon or seasonal positions, and two local written event loci; iconographic stars alone cannot supply a verb. Distinguish a star identity word from an event word.
